mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(t1.market_tenant) as total_num FROM (
SELECT DISTINCT mc.market_tenant FROM market_config mc INNER JOIN property_filing pf ON mc.market_tenant = pf.market_tenant WHERE mc.`status` = 1 ) t1

select pf.property_type from property_filing pf left join market_config mc on mc.market_tenant = pf.market_tenant
mc.status = true
group by pf.property_type
